rawCommits.subject: fix(marketing): fade product hero video bottom into the page
rawCommits.body:
The orb video's scale(1.44) pushed its bottom mask fade past the
wrapper, where .pageHero overflow:hidden clipped it mid-fade and
left a hard horizontal cut. Add bottom padding so the fade fully
renders into --marketing-section-bg like the top, and re-anchor
the marquee overlay to the un-scaled video box so it stays
centered on the orb.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: fade product hero video bottom into the page

rawCommits.cleanSubject: slide nav between center and bottom on side area toggle

rawCommits.subject: fix(public-chat): let transcript fill height and scroll under input bar
rawCommits.body:
Remove the transcript max-height cap and the chat surface bottom margin so messages use the full available height, hide the native scrollbar, and add bottom clearance so messages flow under the floating input bar instead of being cut off above it.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: let transcript fill height and scroll under input bar

rawCommits.subject: fix(scrollbar): round overlay thumb and grow it in the hit area
rawCommits.body:
The overlay scrollbar thumb used a padding + content-box clip trick that only rounded its outer edge, leaving an oddly shaped flat inner edge, and never changed width. Render the visible bar as a rounded ::after pill inside a transparent 12px hit area, and animate it wider on hover/drag.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: round overlay thumb and grow it in the hit area

rawCommits.subject: fix(projects): update task checkmarks in real-time during dev runs
rawCommits.body:
Dev automation completes tasks via `transition_task`, which emits a
`task_updated` status edge rather than the harness `task_completed`
event. The Tasks-tab list hook (`useTaskListData`) already consumed this
edge, but it only subscribes while the Tasks tab is mounted. The
always-mounted `useProjectLayoutData` patched the layout cache for the
lifecycle events but ignored `task_updated`, so `initialTasks` went
stale whenever the user watched the Run tab during a run -- the checkmark
only corrected itself after a manual refresh/refetch.

Subscribe to `task_updated` in `useProjectLayoutData` and patch the
layout cache so the Tasks tab reflects completed tasks on its next mount
regardless of the active sidekick tab. Extract the shared `isTaskStatus`
guard into `task-display-status` so both hooks validate the wire status
identically.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: update task checkmarks in real-time during dev runs

rawCommits.subject: fix(public-chat): re-mint guest token on 401 so chat self-heals
rawCommits.body:
Cached guest tokens are signed with GUEST_JWT_SECRET; a server-side
secret change on deploy left every visitor's persisted token failing
verification with "invalid guest token", and the recovery action
invalidateToken() was never wired up, so desktop and mobile chat were
permanently stuck.

Detect a guest-auth rejection (401 / "guest token" message) via the new
isGuestAuthError predicate, discard the stale token, re-mint a fresh one,
and silently retry the same turn once. Applied to PublicChatView,
MobilePublicChatView, and the dispatch-media boundary (opt-in via reauth).

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: re-mint guest token on 401 so chat self-heals

rawCommits.subject: feat(marketing): live mobile chat mockups on /product agent section

rawCommits.subject: feat(model-picker): show credit multipliers and per-model effort selector
rawCommits.body:
Add a credit-multiplier badge next to each chat model and a hover flyout
to pick a reasoning effort (Low/Medium/High/XHigh/Max) for models that
support it. Effort is persisted per model and forwarded as
`reasoning_effort` on the chat stream request.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: show credit multipliers and per-model effort selector

rawCommits.subject: fix(projects-sidebar): stop dev-run executor agents piling up via local ledger
rawCommits.body:
Each ad-hoc dev/automation task run mints a fresh ephemeral Executor
project_agents row, tagged instance_role=executor + source=system. The
existing sidebar filter and startup janitor both rely on aura-storage
echoing those columns on list_project_agents, but when storage strips
them the rows default to chat + null source: the client filter shows
them and the role-based purge cannot find the orphans. A dev server
restart mid-run kills the in-memory reaper, so every run leaves a
permanent duplicate "Summarize This Me" row.

Add a storage-independent ledger of system-minted (Loop/Executor)
instance IDs persisted in SettingsStore:
- record on create_instance_from_agent_with_role, forget on delete
- purge_executor_instances_in_project drains the ledger by ID first
  (reclaims orphans even when storage stripped instance_role), keeping
  the role scan as a secondary pass
- list_agent_instances excludes ledger-tracked IDs so infrastructure
  rows never render regardless of what storage returns

Pre-existing orphans created before this change carry no ledger entry
and are not auto-removed.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: stop dev-run executor agents piling up via local ledger

rawCommits.subject: feat(media-placeholder): animate loading dot grid with canvas ripple
rawCommits.body:
Replace the static CSS panning dot-grid in the image/video generation placeholder with a canvas where individual dots pulse in radius and brightness in flowing ripple waves, so the wait reads as actively working. Respects prefers-reduced-motion by drawing a single static frame, and guards getContext for jsdom test environments.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: animate loading dot grid with canvas ripple

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): fade generated images in after decode
rawCommits.body:
Generated chat images mounted a bare img element the moment the
generation stream completed, so the bitmap painted in progressively and
the frame grew downward while it downloaded. Gate FadeInImage reveal on
img.decode() and add GeneratedImageFrame, which keeps a loader in a
reserved square box until the image is fully decoded, then fades it in.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: fade generated images in after decode

rawCommits.subject: fix(ci): make setup-node resilient to transient DNS failures
rawCommits.body:
Wrap actions/setup-node in a local ./.github/actions/setup-node composite that polls api.github.com and nodejs.org with backoff before installing, so a transient 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND' blip on the self-hosted runners no longer fails the build-sidecar job on the first attempt. Centralizes the pinned Node version and migrates all first-party workflow usages.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: make setup-node resilient to transient DNS failures

rawCommits.subject: fix(ci): use upstream setup-node in subdirectory-checkout jobs
rawCommits.body:
The publish-manifests and changelog jobs check out the repo into subdirectories (repo/workflow/pages) rather than the workspace root, so the local ./.github/actions/setup-node composite cannot be resolved there ('Can't find action.yml ...'). These jobs all run on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runners that never had the self-hosted DNS issue, so revert just those five steps to actions/setup-node@v5.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: use upstream setup-node in subdirectory-checkout jobs

rendered.title: Self-healing public chat, model effort controls, and steadier CI
rendered.intro: Today's nightly tightens a stack of chat and marketing surfaces, ships per-model reasoning effort in the picker, fixes a long-standing dev-run agent pileup in the Rust core, and hardens release pipelines against transient runner DNS hiccups.

entries.title: Public chat self-heals, model picker gains effort controls
entries.summary: A dense late-evening batch reshaped the chat input, recovered public chat from stale guest tokens, and polished several marketing and layout surfaces.

items.text: Public chat now silently recovers from server-side guest-token secret rotations: a new isGuestAuthError predicate detects 401s, drops the stale cached token, re-mints a fresh one, and transparently retries the turn across PublicChatView, MobilePublicChatView, and the dispatch-media boundary.

The model picker now shows a credit-multiplier badge per chat model and a hover flyout to pick a reasoning effort (Low/Medium/High/XHigh/Max); the selection is persisted per model and forwarded as reasoning_effort on the chat stream request from both desktop and mobile input bars.

The /product page's agent section replaces empty PhoneShell placeholders with three looping mobile chat mockups, each showing a visitor texting a different AURA agent using the landing hero's typewriter and streamed tool-card primitives.

Project task checkmarks now update live during dev runs — useProjectLayoutData subscribes to task_updated edges so the Tasks tab reflects completed work even when the user is watching the Run tab, no manual refresh required.

Smaller layout polish across chat and marketing: the public-chat transcript now fills full height and scrolls under the floating input bar, the public sidebar nav slides between center and bottom on side-area toggle, the marketing product hero video fades cleanly into the page, and the overlay scrollbar thumb is now a properly rounded pill that widens on hover and drag.

entries.title: Ephemeral executor agents stop piling up in the projects sidebar
entries.summary: A Core Rust fix prevents ad-hoc dev/automation runs from leaving permanent duplicate Executor rows in the projects sidebar.

items.text: System-minted Loop/Executor instance IDs are now tracked in a storage-independent SettingsStore ledger, so the janitor can reclaim ephemeral executor rows and the sidebar can hide them even when aura-storage strips the instance_role/source columns and they come back masquerading as plain Chat rows.

entries.title: Media generation feels alive, generated images land cleanly
entries.summary: Two morning changes made image generation in chat feel less janky end-to-end, from the loading placeholder to the final reveal.

items.text: The image/video generation placeholder swaps its static CSS dot grid for a canvas where dots pulse in radius and brightness in flowing ripple waves, so the wait reads as actively working; prefers-reduced-motion still renders a single static frame.

Generated chat images no longer paint in progressively or grow the frame downward as the bitmap arrives: a new GeneratedImageFrame reserves a square box with a loader and FadeInImage now gates its reveal on img.decode(), so the picture appears in one fully-decoded fade.

entries.title: setup-node hardened against self-hosted runner DNS blips
entries.summary: Release Infrastructure wraps setup-node in a reachability gate to absorb transient DNS failures, with a quick follow-up to keep subdirectory-checkout jobs working.

items.text: A new local ./.github/actions/setup-node composite polls api.github.com and nodejs.org with backoff before installing Node, so a transient 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND' on the self-hosted runners no longer kills the build-sidecar job on the first attempt; all first-party workflows now share this wrapper and a centrally pinned Node version.

Five publish-manifest and changelog jobs that check the repo out into subdirectories — where the local composite action can't be resolved — were reverted to upstream actions/setup-node@v5; those run on GitHub-hosted runners that never had the DNS issue in the first place.

highlights: Public chat now self-heals after guest-token rotations
Per-model reasoning effort and credit multipliers in the model picker
Live mobile chat mockups land on the /product page
CI setup-node survives transient DNS failures on self-hosted runners
